notes: Both underdetermined units (v009, v010) carry r00-base and every token is realized in the English.
The ASV's repeated *To them* renders αὐτοῖς; the earlier *to them* renders the substantival article τοῖς, which keeps the pronoun while the participle keeps *that sat* (rules 21, 32).
The second attributive ὁ of ὁ λαὸς ὁ καθήμενος is unrepresented, its head noun being expressed (rules 23, 31).
